items.question: In the UAE, where can you exchange foreign currency at licensed money exchange centres?
items.gold: Licensed money exchange centres are located at airports, in malls and in commercial areas.
items.fact: Licensed UAE exchange centres sit at airports, malls, commercial areas

items.question: Which payment methods are accepted in the UAE for tourists, according to the UAE money and currency guidance?
items.gold: Credit cards, currency cards and traveller's cheques are accepted in the UAE.
items.fact: UAE accepts credit cards, currency cards, traveller's cheques
